title: An LRU cache
description:
Write `public class LruCache<TKey, TValue> where TKey : notnull` that keeps at most `capacity` entries and drops the **least recently used** one when full. Every operation is O(1): combine a `Dictionary<TKey, LinkedListNode<(TKey Key, TValue Value)>>` with a `LinkedList<(TKey Key, TValue Value)>` whose front is the most recently used entry.

- `new LruCache<K, V>(capacity)`; a capacity below 1 throws `ArgumentOutOfRangeException`.
- `bool TryGet(TKey key, out TValue value)`: on a hit, the entry becomes the most recently used.
- `void Set(TKey key, TValue value)`: adds or replaces, and makes the entry the most recently used; when a new key would pass the capacity, the least recently used entry is removed first.
- `int Count` and `IEnumerable<TKey> KeysByRecency` (most recent first).
hints: The dictionary finds a node in O(1); the linked list moves it to the front in O(1) (`Remove(node)` then `AddFirst(node)`). The last node is always the one to drop.
Store the key inside each list entry too: when you drop `_order.Last`, you need its key to remove it from the dictionary as well.
